aggregation: per model: mean over the valid cases (NACA / nozzle) or valid sides (RAE); per seed: paired difference a - b of the same-seed model means; across seeds: mean, SD, 95 % t interval (df 2)
case_rule: GT-based, frozen in configs/gt_shock_cases.json before any benchmark model exists; a case / side without a GT shock receives NO shock metric

claim_rule.V2_shock_advantage_on_dataset: BOTH primaries 'V2 consistently lower' in the dataset's MAIN pair (nozzle: in at least one main pair) AND neither guard metric 'V2 consistently higher' AND, where a decision_context pair exists (NACA F1, nozzle F11), both primaries are also not 'FNO consistently lower' there
claim_rule.otherwise: no shock-capturing difference established on that dataset
claim_rule.pooling: datasets are never pooled into one ranking; Point / Pure models never mixed
claim_rule.secondary: secondary metrics alone (in particular TV) never support a shock-capturing claim

cost: training s/epoch and GPU-h from each run's own log; inference ms/case and peak memory measured in ONE evaluation job per dataset for every model of that dataset (nozzle F10 / F11 / W11: timing of their own D8C / F10M jobs, flagged)
failure_policy: failed cases are never dropped silently: they are counted per model; the metric of a failed case is NaN (never imputed); a pair whose two models have different failure counts on a metric is flagged 'failure-confounded' next to its verdict
failure_rates: predicted shock not detected (rae_shock.detect / nozzle present flag)
physically invalid prediction (p <= 0 from Cp; nozzle p <= 0 / floor)
hypothesis: PointWNO with the canonical V2 kernel captures shocks differently from (better or worse than) a Fourier PointFNO of equal parameter count; no direction is assumed
naca_note: NACA is transonic (M 0.65; 56/120 cases with an LH shock, 7/12 validation cases); it is a shock benchmark on its valid cases and a variable-geometry benchmark on all 12

P1_shock_region_pressure_nrmse.naca: Cp NRMSE (train min-max range) over the frozen GT shock region points (LH candidate box)
P1_shock_region_pressure_nrmse.rae: nrmse_Cp_shock_band (rae_metrics, Lovely-Haimes band of the GT grid, unchanged)

P2_shock_thickness_abs_log_ratio.naca: |ln(width_10_90 pred / GT)| of upper-surface Cp, window +-0.06 c at the frozen GT anchor (shock/profile_metrics)
P2_shock_thickness_abs_log_ratio.nozzle: |ln smear_ratio| of the axis shock (nozzle_metrics_r1_v1 width_10_90 pred / GT, unchanged)
P2_shock_thickness_abs_log_ratio.rae: same on every GT shock side (anchor = CFD shock x); GT = grid GT sampled on the surface

verdict_rule: 'a consistently lower' only if all 3 same-seed differences < 0 AND the 95 % t interval excludes 0; symmetric for b; otherwise 'no detectable difference at n = 3'. Never a p-value or significance claim
